test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can rectify the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to rectify it, select ‘no rectification needed’.

This film is a non-stop riot that many cite as one of the __funny__ films of all time.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is trying **to convey that the film is renowned for being one of the most humorous films ever made.**
 
• The** correct comparative form** to use in this context should be the superlative form** "funniest"** instead of the positive form** "funny".**
 
• ​When comparing three or more items, we use** the superlative form.**
 
• For adjectives with one or** two syllables, we typically add '-est' to the adjective (e.g., funny → funniest).**
 
• Examples:
 
 
• This is **the most **beautiful garden I have ever seen.
 
• She is** the smartest** student in the class.
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement is** "This film is a non-stop riot that many cite as one of the funniest__ films of all time."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Other options are incorrect:
 
 
• **"No rectification needed"** is** incorrect** because the sentence needs a superlative form.
 
• **"More funny"** is** incorrect** because it is not the correct form of comparison.
 
• **"Funnier"** is** incorrect **because it is the comparative form and not the superlative.
